newsitem.title: INDIA: Cricket-India all out for 361, take 179-run lead.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-India all out for 361, take 179-run lead.

text.p: India were all out for 361 in their first innings on the third day of the one-off test against Australia at New Delhi's Feroze Shah Kotla ground on Saturday.
Scores: Australia 182 (M.Slater 44, M.Taylor 27, M.Bevan 26, M.Waugh 26, A.Kumble 4-63, A.Kapoor 2-30, S.Joshi 2-36).
India 361 (N.Mongia 152, S.Ganguly 66, R.Dravid 40, S.Joshi 23, A.Kapoor 22, P.Reiffel 3-35, P.McIntyre 3-103).
